name: A bot fleet: two Bots, a dot and their person
description: A sample, drawn from the two vendors' own documentation as read on 2026-10-05 (docs/fleets/). Nobody here has run it: every handoff is one a vendor's page describes, or a person. Two Grok Bots share the one cloud computer of their person's account and message each other; a dot works on its own cloud computer and hands pieces to threads it starts. Nothing documented passes work from a Bot to a dot, so the person carries it.
